title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 391 (Application of sections 34 to 36 and Chapter XX)

content.overview: Sections 34 to 36 apply to a prospectus issued under section 389 and to the issue of Indian Depository Receipts. Chapter XX applies, with modifications, to the closure of a foreign company's place of business in India.
content.glance: Sections 34 to 36 apply to a prospectus issued under section 389 and to the issue of Indian Depository Receipts. Chapter XX applies, with modifications, to the closure of a foreign company's place of business in India.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 391 (Application of sections 34 to 36 and Chapter XX). Sections 34 to 36 apply to a prospectus issued under section 389 and to the issue of Indian Depository Receipts. Chapter XX applies, with modifications, to the closure of a foreign company's place of business in India. Apply only the conditions, approvals, filings and penalties stated in the section. A rule made under the Act cannot contradict the section. Not a verified closure.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: Misstatement liability tracks the Indian prospectus sections. Closure of an Indian place of business uses the winding-up machinery as adapted. It does not wind up the foreign company itself.
